verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own repo includes a clipboard library implementing file copy-and-paste across Windows, Linux, and macOS, so a clipboard-sharing capability exists. Its depth is unproven, and a hands-on user reports that file copy-paste from Linux to Windows doesn't work. Nothing in the evidence documents text clipboard sync in both directions or a setting to turn clipboard sharing off. Missing for 10: documented bidirectional host↔viewer clipboard sync (including text), a documented toggle to disable clipboard sharing, and independent confirmation that cross-platform clipboard transfer works reliably.

support.subject: As a power user, the clipboard moves both ways between host and viewer, and I can turn that off
